summary.text: Nancy Parker is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Tammy Nichols (R).
Her career experience includes work in healthcare and as a teacher, writer, editor, proofreader and massage therapist.

paragraphs.text: Nancy Parker was born in Indiana and earned a bachelor's degree from Andrews University in 1976.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Indiana, had lived in Alabama, Michigan and Washington, moved to Idaho 40 years earlier, and was retired and raising poultry, fruits and nuts near Middleton.
She said her key messages were fully funding public education, restoring full human rights including bodily autonomy, and protecting public lands and initiative rights.
